title: Loony Pack
description: A texture pack for minecraft that turns vanilla gameplay into fun :)
body:
!WORK IN PROGRESS!

This resource pack includes **500+** redrawn block textures, new item textures, and more! Also this is my first texture pack, so theres nothing too special in it. Some textures like grass, sand, stone have simillar simple textures, but diamond, amethyst shard and emerald have different textures with **different idea**!
![some items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/518476b624406937b69fa96e18ad7510126127fb.png)

If you want to have fun or are tired of boring vanilla textures, please **download** this resource pack. Keep it in your resources folder and **activate it** when you're bored.

**HOW TO INSTALL**: download the **zip file**, then put it in "C:\Users\"YourNameHere"\AppData\Roaming\.minecraft\resourcepacks"
If this resource pack isnt working or some textures are glitched then disable other resource packs in settings or move up in the list this resource pack [Like that](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/17a9a417a203edd3bad469c26eae7ff7857a19b6_0.webp).

Have Fun!
